theorem lg_target (w : CategoryTheory.uliftFunctor.{u, v}.EssSurj) : UnivLE.{max u v, v} := by
  apply CategoryTheory.Localization.essSurj
  use CategoryTheory.uliftFunctor.{u, v}
  use (CategoryTheory.Limits.Types.instPreservesLimitsOfSizeUliftFunctor _ _ _ _).1
  use (CategoryTheory.Limits.Types.instPreservesColimitsOfSizeUliftFunctor _ _ _ _).1
  exact w
